august_increase = august - july

print(f"September increase: {september_increase}")

print(f"\nMean of July/August increases: {mean_inc}")
print(f"Std dev: {std_inc}")

# Calculate z-score
z_score = (september_increase - mean_inc) / std_inc
print(f"\nZ-score: {z_score}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(z_score, 2)}")

# Determine if statistically unusual (threshold > 1.96)
if z_score > 1.96:
    result = "unusual"
else:
    result = "normal"
print(f"\nIs z-score > 1.96? {z_score > 1.96}")
print(f"Result: {result}")
